meta.title: EDUJA — Modern Luxury Logo Exploration
meta.anchor: Premium school management platform with future LPK expansion
meta.summary: Six restrained, contemporary identity directions that imply elephant wisdom through geometry, negative space, and bespoke letter construction rather than mascot imagery.

preserve: works for app icon and promotion
deep EDUJA teal as a core brand color
avoid: literal Hindu Ganesha depiction or religious ornament
academic crest, laurel, shield, graduation cap, open book
visual clutter, glossy 3D, gradients, drop shadows

routes.label: Aureum Trunk
routes.prompt: Create one original modern-luxury logo concept for EDUJA, an Indonesian school management platform, centered on a pure white square inspection background. Route: Aureum Trunk. Draw a near-abstract elephant trunk as one sculptural continuous ribbon with a deliberate asymmetric cut; the silhouette should also suggest an elegant letter J. Use flat solid deep teal #006266 and one tiny muted antique-gold accent #B79A55, with generous whitespace. Pair it with a bespoke uppercase EDUJA wordmark in a high-fashion geometric sans style, wide tracking, precise optical spacing. The mark must feel like premium technology and contemporary architecture, not a school mascot. No gradients, shadows, 3D, texture, mockup, app-tile container, literal elephant face, Ganesha imagery, lotus, crown, shield, book, graduation cap, or tagline.
routes.rationale: Belalai menjadi gestur signature sekaligus membangun huruf J secara subtil.
routes.best_for: Identitas utama yang terasa premium di promosi maupun produk digital.
routes.decision_advice: Pilih jika EDUJA ingin memiliki gestur khas yang elegan dan tidak terlalu literal.
routes.watch_out: Aksen emas harus sangat terbatas agar tidak terasa seperti hotel atau perhiasan.
routes.next_step: Bangun ulang ribbon dengan kurva Bézier dan tes versi teal tunggal.

routes.label: Obsidian E
routes.prompt: Create one original ultra-modern luxury monogram logo concept for EDUJA on a pure white square inspection background. Route: Obsidian E. Construct a capital E from three severe horizontal planes and one curved inner counter; the inner counter quietly becomes an elephant trunk only on second look. Compact square proportion without an enclosing box. Use flat solid near-black obsidian #111718 and deep teal #006266, no gold. Add a restrained bespoke uppercase EDUJA wordmark below in a sharp contemporary grotesk with wide tracking. Strong at 16 px, precise, quiet, expensive, technology-led. No gradients, shadows, bevels, 3D, texture, mockup, literal elephant head, Ganesha imagery, tusks, ears, crown, book, graduation cap, shield, or tagline.
routes.rationale: Monogram E menjadi bentuk primer; metafora gajah hadir sebagai discovery detail.
routes.best_for: Favicon, ikon aplikasi, dan avatar digital.
routes.decision_advice: Pilih jika kesan digital dan kepemilikan huruf lebih penting daripada gajah yang langsung terlihat.
routes.watch_out: Jangan sampai bentuk terbaca sebagai huruf G atau logo fintech generik.
routes.next_step: Uji keterbacaan E dalam ukuran 16 px dan buat tiga proporsi counter-space.

routes.label: Ivory Cut
routes.prompt: Create one original modern-luxury negative-space logo for EDUJA on a pure white square inspection background. Route: Ivory Cut. Start from one calm vertical deep-teal monolith with a refined angled top. Remove a single flowing ivory negative-space cut that reveals an elephant forehead and trunk while also suggesting a forward path. Maximum two visible shapes, architectural proportions, no eyes, ears, tusks, or literal animal outline. Add a bespoke uppercase EDUJA wordmark beneath in a refined modern sans, generous tracking, black ink. Flat solid colors only: deep teal #006266, warm ivory #F3EEE4, obsidian #111718. No gradients, shadows, 3D, texture, mockup, badge, Ganesha imagery, lotus, crown, book, graduation cap, or tagline.
routes.rationale: Satu potongan ruang negatif memberi rasa arsitektural, progresif, dan sangat bersih.
routes.best_for: Logo utama yang konsisten di digital dan cetak satu warna.
routes.decision_advice: Pilih jika identitas perlu terasa tenang, mahal, dan tahan lama.
routes.watch_out: Metafora gajah bisa terlalu samar jika potongan negatif terlalu abstrak.
routes.next_step: Kembangkan rasio monolit dan sudut potongan berdasarkan golden ratio.

routes.label: Axis Elephant
routes.prompt: Create one original high-end geometric logo concept for EDUJA on a pure white square inspection background. Route: Axis Elephant. Build a frontal elephant impression from exactly five flat geometric elements aligned to a strong central axis: two slim ear planes, one narrow forehead, one long trunk, and one small offset terminal. The geometry should feel inspired by contemporary Swiss identity systems and luxury architecture, with controlled asymmetry and unusually tall proportions. Use deep teal #006266, obsidian #111718, and warm ivory #F3EEE4; no gold. Include a custom uppercase EDUJA wordmark below with narrow letterforms and generous spacing. No gradients, shadows, 3D, texture, mockup, literal face, eyes, tusks, deity imagery, lotus, crown, crest, graduation cap, or tagline.
routes.rationale: Proporsi tinggi dan poros tegas memberi karakter premium tanpa ornamen.
routes.best_for: Ikon, signage, presentasi, dan identitas institusional modern.
routes.decision_advice: Pilih jika EDUJA ingin terlihat presisi dan authoritative tanpa menjadi formal-kaku.
routes.watch_out: Simetri dan sumbu tengah harus tetap terasa bespoke, bukan ikon gajah stok.
routes.next_step: Eksplorasi tiga tingkat asimetri dan reduksi menjadi satu warna.

routes.label: Jewel Tusk
routes.prompt: Create one original quiet-luxury logo concept for EDUJA on a pure white square inspection background. Route: Jewel Tusk. Design a sparse abstract mark using two opposing crescent cuts and one central vertical stroke; together they should imply elephant tusks and trunk without showing a face. The overall silhouette should resemble a cut gemstone or precisely folded metal, but remain completely flat and vector-like. Use solid obsidian #111718 as the main mark, deep teal #006266 for one plane, and a tiny muted antique-gold #B79A55 notch. Add an elegant bespoke uppercase EDUJA wordmark below, contemporary high-contrast sans, wide tracking. No gradients, shadows, 3D, metallic texture, mockup, crown, lotus, crest, religious imagery, book, graduation cap, or tagline.
routes.rationale: Mengambil rasa presisi perhiasan melalui potongan bentuk, bukan efek metalik.
routes.best_for: Promosi premium, executive deck, dan aplikasi cetak berkelas.
routes.decision_advice: Pilih jika rasa luxury adalah prioritas utama dan simbol gajah boleh lebih subtil.
routes.watch_out: Bentuk gemstone tidak boleh mengalahkan asosiasi belalai dan gading.
routes.next_step: Hilangkan aksen emas untuk menguji kekuatan bentuk murni.

routes.label: EDUJA Signature
routes.prompt: Create one original wordmark-led modern luxury identity concept for the exact brand name EDUJA on a pure white square inspection background. Route: EDUJA Signature. Make the uppercase word EDUJA the hero using bespoke contemporary letterforms: the lower curve of the U should extend into a restrained elephant-trunk gesture that finishes under the J, creating one continuous signature detail. Keep the remaining letters disciplined, architectural, and widely spaced. Add only one tiny separate abstract glyph derived from the U-to-J trunk for favicon use. Use flat solid obsidian #111718 and deep teal #006266, with no gold. No gradients, shadows, 3D, texture, mockup, serif fashion cliché, literal elephant, Ganesha imagery, lotus, crown, crest, book, graduation cap, or tagline. Ensure the word is spelled exactly EDUJA.
routes.rationale: Merek tampil dewasa dan editorial; metafora gajah hidup di konstruksi huruf.
routes.best_for: Header website, kampanye, dokumen, dan komunikasi corporate.
routes.decision_advice: Pilih jika EDUJA ingin dikenal lewat wordmark, bukan simbol gajah yang dominan.
routes.watch_out: Koneksi U–J harus terbaca elegan dan tidak menyerupai underline dekoratif.
routes.next_step: Redraw lettering secara deterministik dan pisahkan favicon glyph dari wordmark.

next_prompt_hints: prioritize flat solid geometry and optical spacing
test each selected mark in single-color deep teal
redraw the final EDUJA wordmark deterministically
